Schiphol.title: Where will you find your driver at Schiphol?
Schiphol.body: Your driver will be waiting for you at Schiphol after you clear customs. They'll contact you by phone or text to confirm the exact meeting spot — usually near the Meeting Point at Schiphol Plaza. Free Wi-Fi ("Schiphol_Free_Wi-Fi") is available throughout the airport, so you're always reachable.
Schiphol.note: Connecting flight or a delay? Add your flight number when booking — we monitor it automatically.
